summary: Minimal one-line change to Figure.subfigures that forwards explicit margin args (left/bottom/right/top) to the GridSpec constructor, resolving wspace/hspace being ignored; reproduction and regression tests pass. Change is tightly scoped and low-risk.

issues.description: The added arguments pass the same values as GridSpec's defaults (None), so why this line is necessary to make wspace/hspace take effect is non-obvious. A short inline comment explaining the mechanism would help future maintainers and prevent someone from 'cleaning up' the seemingly redundant line.
Explicitly restating default None values reads as redundant at the call site; without context it looks like a no-op, hurting readability.
